dropped.item: Framing of the end-of-day tasks as 'the usual things' I 'found myself doing', which conveyed habit and a semi-automatic quality
The causal link that spending so long thinking of retirement as a date is why the narrator hadn't considered how they would leave

changed.item: 'hadn't given much thought to how I would actually leave the room' became 'never as a way of leaving the room'. The hedged 'not much thought' is now an absolute 'never', and the idea shifts from not having considered *how* to leave the room to never seeing retirement *as* a way of leaving it
'I had spent so long thinking' became 'I had always thought', which raises a long preoccupation to an absolute ('always')
